title: Great variety in this Vía Ferrata - climbs, traverses & zip wire
text: Great fun and quite challenging in places! The location is wonderful with beautiful views all around. Our guide was very attentive, moving back and forth amongst our group to provide any additional help needed. The kids agreed that the zip line was their favourite part! Recommended.
author: C8729WInp

title: Thrilling! We had an awesome time!
text: My sister and I had an excellent time on the via ferrata! Our guide, Dioni, was nice, friendly and kept us safe. The views from the course are spectacular. Its a very cool was to see the countryside and the olive groves from up high. Even the drive to the course was scenic. We loved everything about this tour and would highly recommend it to anyone who enjoys a little physical activity/thrill seeking while traveling.
author: katemattern2
